component.name: SearchScreen
component.script:
sub init() m.top.onResultSelect = invalid m.top.onBack = false m.searchResultsList = m.top.findNode("searchResultsList") m.searchField = m.top.findNode("searchField") end sub
sub performSearch(query as string) result = syncPlaylists(0) if result.ok results = [] for each playlist in result.data.playlists for each channel in playlist.channels ? [] if instr(lcase(channel.name), lcase(query)) > 0 results.push({ title: channel.name, streamUrl: channel.url }) end if end for end for m.searchResultsList.content = createObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") m.searchResultsList.content.append(results) m.searchResultsList.observeField("itemSelected", "onResultSelected") end if end sub
sub onResultSelected() idx = m.searchResultsList.itemSelected if idx >= 0 item = m.searchResultsList.content.getChild(idx) m.top.onResultSelect = { title: item.title, streamUrl: item.streamUrl } end if end sub
sub onKeyDown(key as Integer) if key = 283 m.top.onBack = true end if end sub
